missing_edge_types.same_ip_resolved: requires DNS resolution, which URLGuard does not do
missing_edge_types.same_registrant: requires WHOIS data, which is not collected
missing_edge_types.same_asn: requires IP-to-ASN mapping, which is not collected
missing_edge_types.same_certificate: requires certificate transparency logs, not collected

limitation: Built only from relationships observable in recorded page fetches and structural fingerprints. It carries no DNS, WHOIS, ASN or certificate data, so absence of an edge is not evidence that two domains are unrelated.
